posts.body_html:
Dec 2, 2020 13:37:24 GMT -5 meizzwang said:
With 100% certainty, this IS wilkerson's red rocket! I've never seen it produce traps that look like this, especially in full sun, but it's not surprising. Next time your leucophylla looks "different," keep phenotypic variance in mind:

Similar phenomenon over here. Spring crop was shorter than usual this year but still quite stunning. Coloration is interesting though—very bright white mouth, nearly black veins in the lid, and not much red at all. We’ll see what the fall show looks like.
